legend: Ivan has an array consisting of n different integers. He decided to reorder all elements in increasing order. Ivan loves merge sort so he decided to represent his array with one or several increasing sequences which he then plans to merge into one sorted array.
Ivan represent his array with increasing sequences with help of the following algorithm.
While there is at least one unused number in array Ivan repeats the following procedure:
iterate through array from the left to the right;
Ivan only looks at unused numbers on current iteration;
if current number is the first unused number on this iteration or this number is greater than previous unused number on current iteration, then Ivan marks the number as used and writes it down.
For example, if Ivan's array looks like [1, 3, 2, 5, 4] then he will perform two iterations. On first iteration Ivan will use and write numbers [1, 3, 5], and on second one — [2, 4].
Write a program which helps Ivan and finds representation of the given array with one or several increasing sequences in accordance with algorithm described above.
input: The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·105) — the number of elements in Ivan's array.
The second line contains a sequence consisting of distinct integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 109) — Ivan's array.
output: Print representation of the given array in the form of one or more increasing sequences in accordance with the algorithm described above. Each sequence must be printed on a new line.

legend.ai: Ivan 有一个由 n 个互不相同的整数组成的数组。他决定将所有元素按递增顺序重新排列。Ivan 喜欢归并排序，因此他决定用一个或多个递增序列表示他的数组，然后计划将这些序列合并成一个有序数组。
Ivan 使用以下算法，用递增序列表示他的数组。
当数组中至少存在一个未使用的数字时，Ivan 重复执行以下过程：
Ivan 在当前轮次中只查看尚未使用的数字；
如果当前数字是本轮第一个尚未使用的数字，或者该数字大于本轮前一个尚未使用的数字，那么 Ivan 就将该数字标记为已使用并将其写下。
例如，如果 Ivan 的数组为 [1, 3, 2, 5, 4]，那么他将进行两轮操作。第一轮中，Ivan 将使用并写下数字 [1, 3, 5]；第二轮中，他将使用并写下数字 [2, 4]。
请编写一个程序，按照上述算法，帮助 Ivan 找到将给定数组表示为一个或多个递增序列的方法。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 2·105），表示 Ivan 的数组中的元素个数。
第二行包含一个由互不相同的整数 a1, a2, ..., an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 109）组成的序列——Ivan 的数组。

output.ai: 按照上述算法，将给定数组表示为一个或多个递增序列。每个序列必须单独输出一行。
